title: PlaytestSuite
description: Declarative playtest suite: what runs and where. C# IScenarioProvider/Catalog owns how (ref).

provision.description: managed: Safehouse brings the server up and tears it down. attach: it is already running and playtest touches no lifecycle, config, mods or save.

backend.description: Which server is under test (see playtest_targets.py)

readonly.description: Attach-only: a host playtest must never write to (7dtd-server-container production)

fresh.description: Managed runs are always fresh (must be true). Attach runs do not own the save they join (must be false). Omitted, it follows `provision`: true for managed, false for attach.

server.description: Stock serverconfig properties for this suite, handed to `sb render-config`. Managed only.

mods.description: Modlets staged into the CLIENT instance. A short name resolves to a sibling repo's dist/; anything else is a path relative to the suite file. Omit on a managed run to stage the built-in pair. Managed only: an attach run must not stage mods into an instance it does not own.

server_mods.description: Modlets staged into the SERVER instance. Defaults to the same set as `mods`: the modlet itself must sit in the dedicated server's Mods folder too, and a mod declaring blocks or items has to be on both sides because a multiplayer client receives those definitions from the server. Set it explicitly for an asymmetric pair (a client-only mod that loads no Harmony patch into the dedicated). Managed only: an attach run must not stage mods into an instance it does not own.

kind.description: How the case reads, for tooling and reports. It does NOT select the C# factory: the `ref` implementation (Catalog / IScenarioProvider) decides whether a case runs live, stages a scene, or is deferred.

ref.description: Catalog or IScenarioProvider case implementation id. A ref with no implementation fails the offline surface gate.

barriers.description: Host fixtures this case needs, for tooling. The host does NOT act on it: a case requests a fixture from inside the client with Report.Barrier("spawn_zombie") in its own callback.
